deity.en: Lord Sri Rama, the seventh avatara of Vishnu, with Sita, Lakshmana & Hanuman

observed_on.rule: Chaitra Shukla Navami; Rama's birth is celebrated at madhyahna (noon), the janma muhurtham. Kalyanam (Sitarama celestial wedding) is a highlight in Andhra/Telangana (esp. Bhadrachalam).
observed_on.note: The culmination of Chaitra Navaratri. In Telugu tradition the Sitarama Kalyanam and Panakam/Vadapappu distribution are central.

significance.en: Sri Rama Navami celebrates the birth of Lord Rama, the embodiment of dharma, at noon in Chaitra. Devotees read the Ramayana, perform the Sitarama Kalyanam (the celestial wedding of Rama and Sita), and distribute panakam (jaggery-ginger drink) and vadapappu (soaked moong) as the cooling naivedya of the hot season. Bhadrachalam in Telangana is the great centre of the Kalyanam.
significance.te: శ్రీ రామ నవమి ధర్మస్వరూపుడైన శ్రీరాముని జన్మదినం. మధ్యాహ్నం రాముని జన్మ ఘడియలో పూజ చేసి, సీతారామ కల్యాణం జరిపి, పానకం, వడపప్పు పంచుతారు. భద్రాచలంలో కల్యాణం ప్రసిద్ధం.

name.en: Sri Rama Pattabhishekam idol/picture (Rama, Sita, Lakshmana, Hanuman)
Jaggery, dry ginger, cardamom, pepper (for panakam)

description.en: A concise Rama Navami puja with the Rama Taraka mantra and panakam naivedya.

instruction.en: Bathe, place the Rama picture facing east on the yellow cloth, light the lamp and take the sankalpa at midday.
instruction.te: స్నానం చేసి, రాముని చిత్రాన్ని తూర్పుముఖంగా ఉంచి, దీపం వెలిగించి మధ్యాహ్నం సంకల్పం చెప్పుకోండి.

instruction.en: Meditate on Sri Rama and invoke him with the Taraka mantra.
instruction.te: శ్రీరాముని ధ్యానించి తారక మంత్రంతో ఆవాహన చేయండి.

mantra.sa: श्री राम राम रामेति रमे रामे मनोरमे । सहस्रनाम तत्तुल्यं राम नाम वरानने ॥
mantra.transliteration: Sri Rama Rama Rameti Rame Raame Manorame | Sahasranama Tattulyam Rama Nama Varaanane ||

meaning.en: Repeating 'Rama' thrice equals the thousand names of Vishnu — so said Shiva to Parvati.

instruction.en: Offer gandha, akshata, tulasi, flowers, dhupa and deepa to Rama, Sita, Lakshmana and Hanuman.
instruction.te: గంధం, అక్షతలు, తులసి, పూలు, ధూప దీపాలు సమర్పించండి.

instruction.en: Offer panakam and vadapappu (and fruits), the cooling seasonal naivedya.
Read a Ramayana passage, offer camphor aarti and distribute panakam-vadapappu as prasadam.
instruction.te: రామాయణ పఠనం, హారతి ఇచ్చి పానకం, వడపప్పు పంచండి.

description.en: The full worship with shodashopachara, Sri Rama Ashtottara and the Sitarama Kalyanam.

instruction.en: Clean the space, draw a muggu, perform achamana and pranayama, and take the detailed midday sankalpa.
instruction.te: స్థలం శుభ్రపరచి, ముగ్గు వేసి, ఆచమనం చేసి మధ్యాహ్న సంకల్పం చెప్పుకోండి.

instruction.en: Establish the kalasham, light the lamps and worship Ganapati to remove obstacles.
Meditate on Sri Ramachandra with Sita on his lap and invoke the divine family.
Offer the sixteen services from avahana to mantrapushpa to Rama, Sita, Lakshmana and Hanuman.
instruction.te: ఆవాహన నుండి మంత్రపుష్పం వరకు షోడశోపచారాలు సమర్పించండి.

instruction.en: Recite the 108 names of Sri Rama with tulasi and flowers.
Read the janma passage of the Bala Kanda or a Sundarakanda chapter.
instruction.te: బాలకాండ జన్మ ఘట్టం లేదా సుందరకాండ పఠనం.

instruction.en: Perform the celestial wedding: tie the mangalasutra, shower talambralu (turmeric rice) and sing the kalyana songs.
instruction.te: మంగళసూత్రధారణ, తలంబ్రాలు, కల్యాణ గీతాలతో సీతారామ కల్యాణం జరపండి.

instruction.en: Offer panakam, vadapappu, kosambari and fruits as the seasonal naivedya.
Offer camphor aarti and distribute panakam and vadapappu to all.

item.en: Dry ginger, cardamom, pepper, a little edible camphor

steps.en: Dissolve jaggery in water and strain.
Add dry ginger, cardamom, crushed pepper and a pinch of edible camphor.
Offer chilled as the cooling naivedya of Rama Navami.

offering_note.en: The signature Rama Navami offering, cooling for the hot Chaitra season.

item.en: Grated coconut, green chilli, ginger, salt

steps.en: Soak moong dal 2-3 hours and drain.
Mix with grated coconut, finely chopped chilli, ginger and salt.

offering_note.en: Paired with panakam as the classic Rama Navami prasadam.

meaning.en: Salutations to Lord Sri Rama, the embodiment of dharma.

audio.note: Populate with a Supabase Storage path for the Rama Navami / Kalyanam narration.

source: Compiled for the Pavitra app; follows the standard South-Indian Sri Rama Navami and Sitarama Kalyanam tradition.
disclaimer: Regional and family practices vary. Treat as a respectful general guide, not a substitute for family or priestly tradition.
